ticket-autopilot.alt: An Autopilot rule combines timing relative to the event with an action. Review the resulting timeline before saving.

email-confirmation.alt: Manage Ticket Confirmation to edit the subject, custom message, confirmation actions, and attachments.

email-attachments.alt: Use confirmation action switches for ticket and wallet links. Upload PDF adds your own attachments, with up to five files per email.

email-campaign-message.title: Compose an event message

email-campaign-message.alt: Compose the announcement and choose ticket actions and PDF attachments. Send Announcement submits it to the selected recipients.

membership-list.title: Membership list and create entry

membership-list.alt: Memberships shows program price, duration, assigned events, inventory, holder totals, and status. Create Membership adds a program; Edit changes an existing one.

membership-details.alt: Name the membership and describe its benefits. This Demo Yoga Pass is a documentation example.

membership-pricing.alt: Set the one-time price, benefit duration, and optional membership sales window. The summary keeps these separate from visit limits.

membership-access.alt: Set total visits, visits per event, and memberships available independently. This saved example allows ten visits, one per event, with 100 memberships for sale.

membership-event-assignment.alt: Select included events for the membership. Event-level Memberships settings decide whether holders enter directly or reserve a ticket.

membership-details-images.title: Membership details, images and status

membership-details-images.alt: Images appear during checkout and on membership cards. Upload PNG, JPEG, or WEBP files within the displayed size limit.

membership-numbering.title: Member-number formats and preview
membership-numbering.caption: Enable member numbers and choose a format, prefix, length, and starting number. Review the preview before creating the membership.
membership-numbering.alt: Enable member numbers and choose a format, prefix, length, and starting number. Review the preview before creating the membership.

membership-list-saved.title: Membership list and create entry
membership-list-saved.caption: The membership list shows price, duration, event assignments, inventory, holders, and status. Edit reopens the program settings.
membership-list-saved.alt: The membership list shows price, duration, event assignments, inventory, holders, and status. Edit reopens the program settings.

membership-event-panel.title: Assign membership from an event
membership-event-panel.caption: Each event membership has separate checkout availability, event access, admission mode, and per-member entry limits.
membership-event-panel.alt: Each event membership has separate checkout availability, event access, admission mode, and per-member entry limits.

membership-event-panel-admission.caption: Edit settings separates selling the membership at checkout from granting event access. Choose direct admission or a required reservation and set entries per member.
membership-event-panel-admission.alt: Edit settings separates selling the membership at checkout from granting event access. Choose direct admission or a required reservation and set entries per member.

membership-event-panel-custom-window.title: Assign membership from an event
membership-event-panel-custom-window.caption: Direct admission can use a custom window: minutes before event start for opening, and minutes after event end for closing.
membership-event-panel-custom-window.alt: Direct admission can use a custom window: minutes before event start for opening, and minutes after event end for closing.

membership-event-panel-defaults.title: Assign membership from an event
membership-event-panel-defaults.caption: Membership check-in settings sets the event defaults for direct admission. Reservations follow the ticket’s check-in rules.
membership-event-panel-defaults.alt: Membership check-in settings sets the event defaults for direct admission. Reservations follow the ticket’s check-in rules.

membership-ticket-price.title: Member price versus public price
membership-ticket-price.caption: Enable Member pricing, select eligible programs, and enter a member price. This example offers a $15 member ticket against the $25 regular price.
membership-ticket-price.alt: Enable Member pricing, select eligible programs, and enter a member price. This example offers a $15 member ticket against the $25 regular price.

membership-ticket-access.title: Members-only ticket access
membership-ticket-access.caption: Members only restricts ticket purchase to the selected active membership programs. Choose at least one eligible membership, then save the ticket and event.
membership-ticket-access.alt: Members only restricts ticket purchase to the selected active membership programs. Choose at least one eligible membership, then save the ticket and event.

waitlist-settings.title: Waitlist settings and triggers
waitlist-settings.caption: Enable Waitlist, then choose whether sold-out tickets or event capacity should show the waitlist. Invitation-only capacity controls require an event capacity.
waitlist-settings.alt: Enable Waitlist, then choose whether sold-out tickets or event capacity should show the waitlist. Invitation-only capacity controls require an event capacity.

waitlist-settings-messages.title: Waitlist settings and triggers
waitlist-settings-messages.caption: Customize the waitlist button, description, and on-screen confirmation. The confirmation message shown here is separate from an email.
waitlist-settings-messages.alt: Customize the waitlist button, description, and on-screen confirmation. The confirmation message shown here is separate from an email.

waitlist-fixed-capacity.alt: With capacity 50 and a waitlist threshold of 40, public bookings stop at 40. Invited purchases use the remaining capacity without increasing the event limit.

waitlist-invitation-only.title: Invitation-only access with threshold zero
waitlist-invitation-only.caption: A threshold of zero makes purchases invitation-only from the start, while the event capacity remains the maximum.
waitlist-invitation-only.alt: A threshold of zero makes purchases invitation-only from the start, while the event capacity remains the maximum.

waitlist-queue-status.title: Queued, skipped and failed invitations

waitlist-queue-status.alt: Subscribers shows the real waitlist entry, its ticket, pending invitation status, and date added. Select the intended guest before Notify Guests.

waitlist-queue-status-filter.title: Queued, skipped and failed invitations
waitlist-queue-status-filter.caption: The subscriber filter separates notified and not-notified guests. Inspect each row for the current invitation status.
waitlist-queue-status-filter.alt: The subscriber filter separates notified and not-notified guests. Inspect each row for the current invitation status.

email-confirmation-test.title: Event confirmation message setup

seating-chart-create-designer.title: Create and publish a chart

seating-chart-create-seat-category.alt: Select rows or seats and choose a Category. The same properties panel controls row and seat labels, spacing and orientation.

seating-chart-create-published.title: Create and publish a chart

seating-chart-create-published.alt: Confirm the chart is Published in Seat Charts before assigning it to an event. Rename with the pencil; the actions menu contains Edit, Duplicate and Delete.

seating-chart-assign.alt: Enable Assigned Seating in Tickets and choose a published chart. Wait for the saved confirmation, then assign seat categories to tickets below.
